fact: On 2 February 2025 CLCPRO and the Algerian Space Agency signed an agreement under which ASAL provides satellite data on areas favourable to desert locust development and trains national experts, for integration into CLCPRO's monitoring and alert mechanisms.
title: [Partnership] CLCPRO x ASAL: A Strategic Partnership for Enhanced Desert Locust Surveillance
publisher: FAO, Desert Locust Control Commission in the Western Region (CLCPRO)
